# GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Regenerate with tools/gen_highscore.py
# Executed via GetScriptedGui().Execute from the GUI import states.
# Sets the imported record value; at game start (shop pending) also copies
# it into this run's spendable points (the shop event itself is fired
# separately by the game-start on_action with a 1-day delay).

xar_import_0_gui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		debug_log = "XAR: import state fired k=0"
		set_global_variable = {
			name = xa_global_record_imported
			value = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = xa_shop_pending }
			remove_global_variable = xa_shop_pending
			set_global_variable = {
				name = xa_local_points
				value = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		debug_log = "XAR: import state fired k=15100"
		set_global_variable = {
			name = xa_global_record_imported
			value = 15100
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = xa_shop_pending }
			remove_global_variable = xa_shop_pending
			set_global_variable = {
				name = xa_local_points
				value = 15100
			}
		}
	}
}
